message.content: {"count":3,"rationale":"Block fileServer:lateralMovement, domainAdmin:privilegeEscalation, and hypervisor:privilegeEscalation. Blocking fileServer also disables secretsManager, so all four parents of the target become unreachable. Two blocks cannot suffice: stopping codeRepo requires blocking codeRepo itself, fileServer, or both dbLogin and tokenCache. Blocking both dbLogin and tokenCache leaves domainAdmin reachable. After blocking fileServer, no single additional step disables both domainAdmin and hypervisor. After blocking codeRepo, no single additional step disables secretsManager, domainAdmin, and hypervisor. Thus three is minimal."}
